{"consolidated_memory":"## Dropped Rows in ingest/pipeline/dedupe.py — Two Root Causes (2026-03-03 and 2026-05-15)

**OCCASION 1: 2026-03-03 — Unicode Normalisation Issue**
- Component: ingest/pipeline/dedupe.py (ingest side)
- Problem: Dropped rows in dedupe stage
- Trigger: Discovered after rolling restart of the fleet
- Signal: Output count below input count
- Root cause: Missing Unicode normalisation before hashing
- Fix: Normalised to NFC ahead of the digest
- PR: #1800 on branch fix/dropped-rows-1
- Repro: Run the pipeline over overlapping day partitions
- Result: Nightly rollup matched source counts for 80 days running

**OCCASION 2: 2026-05-15 — Mutable Default Argument Issue**
- Component: ingest/pipeline/dedupe.py (ingest side)
- Problem: Dropped rows in dedupe stage
- Trigger: Turned up only for users sitting in negative UTC offset
- Signal: Output count below input count
- Root cause: Mutable default argument shared across calls
- Fix: Made the default empty and built the value per call
- PR: #4744 on branch fix/dropped-rows-2
- Repro: Run the pipeline over overlapping day partitions
- Result: Reclaimed 70 GB of blob storage

Both issues occurred in the same codebase corner, same symptom, same reproduction method, but distinct root causes requiring separate fixes in different PRs."}
